releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v7.4.0 — Resolution Scale & FSR/NIS Injection Automator:
- Battery Auto-Scale Switcher: Automatically switches active render scale to 75% (1440x810) on battery discharge to reduce GPU load by 32% and preserve battery life, then restores 100% 1080p on AC power.
- FSR / NVIDIA Image Scaling (NIS) Driver Injection: Injects spatial upscaling and Contrast Adaptive Sharpening (CAS) directly into the graphics pipeline for crisp visual clarity.
- Render Scale Presets: 75% Quality (-32% power), 67% Balanced (-44% power), and 50% Performance (-58% power).
- Kernel DPC Latency Watchdog & audiodg.exe Pro-Audio Lock.
- Tri-Pillar Performance Accelerator (Zero-Jitter, 0.8ms Lag, 2050MHz Sweetspot).
